evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'I just need about ten to fifteen minutes to verify your upcoming move. Okay?' — framing present (time-boxed), but she doesn't wait for a yes before plunging into logistics ('your move is on for the 17th of October...').
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'Alright, and aside from the pro, do you have any important concerns or instructions for this move that you also want to discuss on this call?' — asked, but only after confirming the move date and addresses, so after probing has already started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'Not specially' to the agenda question; no concerns were raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Apartment numbers (534 current, 327 new) confirmed; floor level (5th floor with elevator) clarified; all furniture items itemized (bed, box spring, desk, chair, sofa, TV stand, dining table, dining chairs, patio chairs); boxes (25 estimated); walking distances (parking to elevator >100 ft, elevator to door >100 ft for current; new apartment also >100 ft estimated). All seven logistics categories covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Joanna: 'But you're packing all the boxes yourself, or do you need help with that as well?' — Dosoo: 'I will do my by myself.' Offered and declined.
evidence_quotes.box_count: Joanna: 'How many school buses do you think is the distance?' [after establishing the typical 15-25 box range]. Dosoo: 'maybe 25.' Box count asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'Typically an apartment your size usually takes two and a half to three and a half hours to come complete. But in your case... we will add time for this move because of the walking distance... so for now, I'll just call your move more on the four to five hour mark, which is an estimated budget of $1,020.' — anchor given ($204/hr × ~5 hrs) and personalized to walking distance concern.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: 'What's good about our pricing, it's all includes rates everything we need to complete your move is already in that price. So the two men and the truck, all the reps to protect your items... all of that is already included.' Fee transparency present. Also: 'we only charge for every fifteen minutes' and '2.5 hour minimum.' Both disclosed.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly to 'I'll send everything to you in an email' without asking if the estimate feels fair or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Joanna: 'on time guarantee if we run late on... The time that we schedule, we provide discounts for your move... if we didn't arrive within that window, then we will give you a discount for your move.' — delivered in full with discount framing.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Joanna: 'we will also include other features like our no worries, damage coverage. Which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages.' — mentions $2,000 and that it's included, but does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print.' Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna: 'Alright, you're all set for the Saturday of October' — does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing confirmation. Also, the call then restarts when customer raises a new question about desk protection, so the section does not cleanly close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright. Any other questions?' — throwaway phrasing; not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' variant.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep says 'I'll go ahead and send everything to you in an email' and 'if you have any further questions just let us know' but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. The call ends with the rep saying goodbye without a direct ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate locks or holding the estimate.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Move date (October 17, Saturday, 8:30–9:00 AM window) and addresses confirmed; however, phone number not confirmed in the closing, crew size not confirmed, and no notes left for crew about customer concerns (e.g., walking distance, desk protection). Missing 2+ items.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (all seven items: property type as studio, floor/elevator, all furniture itemized, boxes, and both walking distances) and transparently explained pricing structure, hourly rate, 2.5-hour minimum, and 15-minute increments before quoting.
coaching_note: Close every call with an explicit ask for the business ('Would you like our help with your move?') — this call ended with an email offer and no ask, and never confirm booking details (phone, crew size, crew notes about concerns) before saying goodbye.
